# Assignment: Restore a project from a backup

**Estimated time:** 45 minutes
**Review:** mentor
**Submit:** text

## Brief

A translation team's laptop has failed. LEARNER-BRIEF-LINE: Using the backup file the team
sends you, restore their project on a second machine and describe each step you took.

## What to submit

LEARNER-SUBMIT-LINE: a short written account of the restore, in your own words.

## Criteria

### Locates the backup (2 points)

LEARNER-CRITERION-ONE: Finds the most recent backup and says how they confirmed its date.

### Verifies the restore (3 points)

LEARNER-CRITERION-TWO: Shows that the restored project opens and its notes are present.

## Mentor only: grading notes

### Locates the backup

MENTOR-NOTES-ONE: full marks only if the learner checked the date inside the archive,
not just the file name.

### Verifies the restore

MENTOR-NOTES-TWO: a learner who opens the project but never checks the notes earns 1 point.

## Mentor only: model answer

MENTOR-MODEL-LINE: The consultant asks for the newest backup, checks its internal date,
restores to a fresh folder and opens three books to confirm the notes came across.

#### A deeper heading stays inside the block

MENTOR-MODEL-DEEP: still part of the model answer.

## Before you start

LEARNER-BEFORE-LINE: Make sure you have a second machine with the editor installed.

## Mentor only

MENTOR-EXTRA-LINE: if the learner asks, point them to the backup lesson, not the answer.
